'''2002 World Championship Top 8 Hayes Hunter LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Hayes Hunter]] at [[2002 World Championship]] (Top 8), finishing 5th; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/hayesLS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: Watch Your Step]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2002 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Finish:''' 5th
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watch Your Step
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/hayesLS.pdf PC decklist form]
